decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are first occupied/used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby approved for use as a garage shall only be used for the parking of private motor vehicles and retained as such. The parts of the outbuilding shown on plans numbered  449/1, 449/A4, 12, 13, 14, 15 & 16 for use as additional store and bedrooms shall remain ancillary to the residential use of the main dwellinghouse.

Condition : 6 - Full details, with samples, of all surface treatments including the roof of the studio and the link building shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing before any work on the site is commenced.  The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.
description: Demolition of existing garage and the erection of a two storey extension at rear end of garden attached to main dwellinghouse by a single storey rear link exetnsion
